turns.question: Of the customers who signed up in August 2026, what share had bought from us by 10 October 2026?
turns.answer: About 36% (4 of the 11 customers who signed up in August 2026) had placed a non-cancelled order by 10 October 2026, counting orders from 1 August to 10 October 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
